answers.core: In addition to not being possible currently, I don't think it makes sense from an engineering perspective to give scripts direct, real-time access to the audio server. There would be lots of questions there as to how to quickly marshal the data back and forth between script-world and engine-world.
answers.workaround: Without access to the AudioServer, there isn't anything a script can do to extend the audio system in this way.

title: SoundProbe based reverb/attenuation baking and HRTF audio rendering for XR
